title: Untraced compute pool accounting framework
definition: Non-negative residual quantity produced by reconciling sourced accelerator acquisitions/sales/transfers/decommissioning against independently verified physical end-use assignments.
rules: Keep chip units and compute capacity as separate measures.
Do not count aggregate ownership snapshots as physical site inventories.
Residual is UNKNOWN when the input population is not closed.
When inputs are closed, residual must be >= 0.

current_snapshot.reason: Current public sources do not form a closed transaction-level inventory chain across all compute owners and sites.
